notes: 英文是在遊戲外執行模組註冊文字的程式記錄下來的。車體與炮塔的名稱、數值，以及技能說明最後「技能數值」裡的重量，是模組從內嵌資源包的零件資料算出來的，這裡依 2.3.11 版資源包的內容。
技能說明的「技能數值」區塊（冷卻時間、爆炸半徑、重量）只在設定 Show Extra Skill Info 開啟（預設）時出現；關掉的話英文會少這一段，譯文仍會顯示。
XTRA_ 開頭的是 Mega War Tank（設定 Add Xtra Tank，預設關閉）；SCEPTER 是裝了 Ancient Scepter 模組時的強化技能。
鍵是英文的兩條（Celestial War Tank、War Tank）：模組直接把英文當作 AI 坦克的名稱 token，用英文原文當鍵來翻譯。
燃料量表、坦克編輯器的下拉選單等文字是直接寫到畫面上的，翻不到。

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_DESCRIPTI.en:
This silly powerhouse can be customized and tuned to various strengths, while being capable of using its many, many weapons to deal with all sorts of foes.

<style=cSub>< ! > Customize your loadout to bring your style of play! Adjust base and unique stats to suit around the tank’s awful regeneration and vertical mobility.

< ! > Be careful of your limited fuel, which affects jump, utilities, and other miscellaneous. Mobility items can aid your fuel’s recharge and limit.

< ! > Tank can climb and ramp off odd terrain with ease. Using utilities can launch you further into the air, allowing you to perform tricks beyond the tank’s odds.

< ! > Tank crashes when landing upside down. However, landing flips grants you speed, fuel, recharges, and negates fall damage!

< ! > Press 'T' to honk.  Configurable in mod settings.

</style>

這輛傻呼呼的火力怪獸可以自由改裝、調校出各種不同的強項，還能動用它多到數不清的武器，對付各式各樣的敵人。

<style=cSub>< ! >自訂你的配置，打出你自己的風格！調整基礎屬性與獨特屬性，來配合戰車糟糕的生命值再生與垂直機動性。

< ! >留意有限的燃料，跳躍、輔助技能和其他各種動作都會用到它。機動類物品可以加快燃料恢復並提高燃料上限。

< ! >戰車能輕鬆爬上各種奇形怪狀的地形，還能藉坡飛起。使用輔助技能可以把你送得更高，讓你做出戰車本來辦不到的特技。

< ! >戰車頭下腳上著地就會翻車。不過，翻轉後成功著地可以獲得速度、燃料與技能充能，還能免除跌落傷害！

< ! >按「T」鍵按喇叭。可在模組設定中更改按鍵。

</style>

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_LORE.en:
We do not know where this thing originates from. We have only found them in the backpacks of the scavengers.
This discovery was found by one man, who kept looping around teleporter after teleporter, fighting scavengers day and night. When one day, while he was scrounging through the big 'ol backpack, he found a tank!

"This thing quickly gained sentience," he said. "It was vicious! It tried to run me over! Thank goodness for its rather small size and slow speed. I tried to make it stop, but its armor was immaculate!"

"How did you get it to be your friend?"

"Well, I eventually ruined its track."

"Doesn't it have weapons, though?"

"It kind' a ran out of the bag, with a missing guns and parts. So, after catching my breath, I eventually scrounged the sack for anything else- and behold! All sorts of different barrels, guns, ammunition, and parts! That seems like it was made for it!"

"I'm assuming you put it on the tank, and it just... trusted you?"

"...Yeah, pretty much. I didn't have much to live for, anyway- so why not try and make at least some friend?"

"I see. Well, what's that bomb that's been collecting dust, on your desk?"

"Oh, something I never let silly 'ol billy touch. It looks like a rather violent device. Perhaps a nuclear device? Yeah, I won't let him touch that! Probably could kill him, too!"

"Huh. It could probably be put to good use though, if your life is ever at stake."

"I don't know, man. I don't know if I want to lose him. He's kind of a sweetheart, you know? And a nice little body shield."
CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
我們不知道這東西從何而來，只曾在清道夫的背包裡發現過它們。
最早發現它們的是一名男子。他穿過一個又一個傳送器，不斷循環，日以繼夜地和清道夫搏鬥。直到某天，他在清道夫那個大背包裡東翻西找時，竟然翻出了一輛戰車！

「這東西很快就有了自我意識，」他說，「而且兇得很！它還想輾過我！幸好它個頭不大、速度又慢。我想讓它停下來，可是它的裝甲完美無瑕！」

「那你是怎麼跟它變成朋友的？」

「這個嘛，最後我把它的履帶弄壞了。」

「可是它不是有武器嗎？」

「它衝出袋子的時候，身上好像少了槍和一些零件。所以等我喘過氣來，就在那袋子裡翻找還有沒有別的東西——結果你猜怎樣！各式各樣的炮管、槍枝、彈藥和零件，應有盡有！簡直就像是專門為它打造的！」

「我猜你把那些裝到戰車上，然後它就……信任你了？」

「……對，差不多就是這樣。反正我也沒剩什麼活下去的理由——那何不至少試著交個朋友？」

「原來如此。那麼，你桌上那顆積了灰的炸彈是什麼？」

「喔，那是我從來不讓傻呼呼的老比利碰的東西。看起來是個相當暴力的裝置，說不定是核子裝置？對，我絕對不會讓他碰那個！搞不好連他都會被炸死！」

「嗯。不過萬一哪天你命懸一線，它說不定能派上用場。」

「我不知道耶，老兄。我不確定自己捨不捨得失去他。他其實還挺貼心的，你懂吧？而且還是一面很棒的小肉盾。」

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_PASSIVE_D.en:
Utilities and thrust consume fuel. Fuel replenishment is affected by <style=cIsUtility>attack speed</style>; fuel capacity is affected by <style=cIsUtility>afterburners</style> and <style=cIsUtility>jump-induced items</style>. Tank can <style=cIsUtility>sprint in any direction</style>.

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_PASSIVE2_.en:

Armor or speed can help assuage the tank’s <color=#fc8080>abysmal health regeneration</color>.
CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_PASSIVE2_.zh-TW:

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_BODY_PASSIVE3_.en: Tank cannot re-balance itself in the air, <color=#ffff80>being prone to losing control</color>. Landing on your head leaves you <color=#fc8080>immobilized and vulnerable for a short time</color>.

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_XTRA_BODY_DESC.en:
The ultimate tank of destruction. Resist all types of foes, running and crushing them with its mighty weight and weapons!

<style=cSub>< ! > Tank is huge, and heavily slow, making you susceptible to any form of damage. Playing either extremely defensive or aggressive will help mitigate the amount of damage you will take. Know that the tank has no healing.

< ! > The tank’s body can be used for damage- run your enemies over or use your weight to squish them all!

< ! > When tank crashes, it’s heavier and it takes a while to get back up, susceptible to more fall damage. Tank cannot do stunts.

< ! > Healing factors are mitigated- tank has too much health!

< ! > Press 'T' to honk.  Configurable in mod settings.

</style>
CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_XTRA_BODY_DESC.zh-TW:
終極毀滅戰車。無懼各種敵人，用它驚人的重量與武器把敵人輾過、壓扁！

<style=cSub>< ! >戰車體型巨大、速度極慢，很容易受到各種形式的傷害。採取極度防守或極度激進的打法，都有助於減少你承受的傷害。請注意，戰車沒有任何治療手段。

< ! >戰車的車身本身就能造成傷害——輾過敵人，或用你的重量把他們全部壓扁！

< ! >戰車翻車時，因為車身更重，需要一段時間才能翻回來，也會受到更多跌落傷害。戰車無法做特技。

< ! >治療效果會被削弱——戰車的生命值實在太多了！

< ! >按「T」鍵按喇叭。可在模組設定中更改按鍵。

</style>

CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_XTRA_BODY_LORE.en:
Upon further research, we have found some origin to these tanks- the hands of the scavengers. Crafted by quality scrap parts and items from the UES, they had successfully created these war tanks.

However, this leads to dangerous conclusions. After obtaining one of the enemy antennas, we have alerted this behemoth sized of a tank. It’s the size of beetle guards!

Of course after a long-fought battle, we have finally taken it down. We hope to take further research and re-alter its mind, in hopes to get better answers. It’ll be a difficult task at that, for it IS alien technology.

One humongous note to take in, is that upon its defeat, it had summoned an emergency portal. The largest, most violent portal we have ever seen. As much as it might lead us straight into answers, I don’t think it’s going to be a cakewalk in the park. An average tank is far too deadly, and I’m not sure what other inventions made by the scavengers are out there.
CHEESEWITHHOLES_BASICTANK_XTRA_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
經過進一步研究，我們找到了這些戰車的部分來歷——它們出自清道夫之手。清道夫用尤伊思的優質廢料零件和物品，成功打造出了這些戰車。

然而，這也引出了危險的結論。我們取得一具敵方天線之後，竟然驚動了這輛巨獸般的戰車。它足足有甲殼蟲守衛那麼大！

當然，經過一場漫長的苦戰，我們終於把它擊倒了。我們希望能進一步研究，並重新改造它的心智，好得到更確切的答案。這會是一項艱鉅的任務，畢竟這可是不折不扣的外星科技。

有一點必須特別記下：它被擊敗時，召喚出了一道緊急傳送門——那是我們見過最巨大、最狂暴的傳送門。雖然它或許能直接帶我們找到答案，但我不認為那會是什麼輕鬆愜意的公園散步。一輛普通的戰車就已經致命至極，我也不確定外頭還有哪些清道夫造出來的發明。
